evidence.summary: Run bounded at 600 s (measured 266/234 s round 1; 313 s for the 09:30 run on the round 2 worker); per-site spacing; refused site gets no further requests in the run or until the pause ends; dead links backed off after 3 (skipped_backoff 42 live). Round 2: the site pause store is now Redis (app redis_url, db 0; live check RedisSitePauseStore), shared by the worker and the API manual poll and surviving a worker restart; process-local fallback only when Redis is unreachable, warned once; code errors raised. Worker-only restart left wsl/redis/api/web healthy.

rationale: Limits recorded: solo worker busy about 5 of every 30 min; in-flight Takealot check can overrun by up to 60 s; no Celery hard time limit; pause survives worker restarts but not a Redis flush, and consecutive_failures stays in meta_json, until U2 migrations; during a Redis outage pauses are per process again. Round 1 claimed the pause was in Redis when it was not (GOV-008 D1).
